problems: The flap does not hold together as one piece of leather. The front panel stops 0.02 below the top of the case. The top panel starts at y=-0.114, behind the front panel's back face at y=-0.119. That leaves an open slot at the fold, so the top panel reads as a loose slab or lid sitting on the case. Fix: the two panels now overlap at the fold, and a rounded fold roll joins them along the top front edge.

The top panel ends partway across the case's depth, so the handle mounts sit half on the flap and half on the body. Fix: the top panel now runs far enough back to cover the mounts and has a clear back edge where it hinges to the body.
